name: @mrrisega/dsh-remote
description: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web) from any phone browser: tunnel-mode relay client with one-command install, self-hosting support, and a dsh web plugin panel

scripts.test: npm run test:router && npm run test:plugin && npm run test:bridge
scripts.check: node --check clients/dsh-remote/dsh-bridge.mjs && node --check dsh-setup.mjs && node --check packages/dsh-remote-ui/lib/index.js && node --check packages/dsh-remote-ui/lib/client.js && bash -n deploy/install-open.sh
